en.metaDescription: Discover Subic Bay Gateway Park — a world-class industrial park with modern infrastructure in the Subic Bay Freeport Zone.
en.title: Subic Bay Gateway Park
en.subtitle: Description, Infrastructure & Master Plan
en.descriptionPara1a: Subic Bay Gateway Park (SBGP) is a
en.descriptionPara1c: situated within the Subic Bay Freeport Zone. It offers a strategic location with easy access to the Subic Bay International Airport, the Subic Bay Seaport, and the major highway networks of Luzon.
en.descriptionPara2: SBGP is designed to accommodate a wide range of industries, including light manufacturing, logistics, warehousing, and business process outsourcing (BPO). The park provides a secure, well-maintained environment with modern facilities and infrastructure.
en.infraPowerDesc: Reliable electricity with backup generators and redundant supply lines.
en.infraWaterDesc: Adequate water supply with treatment facilities and fire hydrant system.
en.infraTelecomDesc: High-speed fiber optic internet and telecommunications infrastructure.
en.infraRoadsDesc: Well-maintained internal road network with proper lighting and signage.
en.infraSecurityDesc: 24/7 security monitoring, controlled access, and CCTV surveillance.
en.infraWasteDesc: Proper waste collection, disposal services, and drainage systems.
en.masterPlanDesc: The master plan of SBGP includes zoned areas for different types of industrial activities, green spaces, commercial areas, and support facilities. The park is designed for future expansion to accommodate growing demand.
en.accessibilityDesc: SBGP is designed to be accessible to all, with compliant facilities and pathways for persons with disabilities. The park follows universal design principles to ensure inclusivity.
en.videoDesc: Contact us for video presentations showcasing the park's facilities and locator opportunities.
